body:
Past releases can be browsed from the Build tab, which today shows only the newest release.

- A list of builds: version, date, status, and the source commit it was built from.
- Each release shows its artifacts (download, open folder), release notes and build log.
- Compare two releases by the tasks and features that went in between them.

Depends on: build: release notes from tasks.
title: build: release history
